contexts.text: The human mind consists of two parts... AC 801:2. HH 367. TCR 498.
Parts including parts (a learned phrase).
The will is the primary part...
When the intellectual part has been instructed...
The Church on the one side, and the Lord on the other. Signified.
He laid each part of it overagainst the other () = parallelism and correspondence as to celestial things; (for) the parts on one side = the Church; and the parts on the other, the Lord...
The middle space between the parts = that with man which is called perception, internal dictate, and conscience.
Such as the general is, such is the part of the general; for the parts must be like their general, in order to be of it.
There is an influx of all, or of the general, into the singles, or parts.
These three parts of man communicate in a marvellous manner...

Appoint him his portion with the hypocrites () = his lot, which is the portion with those who outwardly appear to be in truth as to doctrine, and in good as to life; but who inwardly believe nothing of truth, and will nothing of good.
The things subject to the intellectual part. Treated of.
The Lord wills man's total submission, that is, that he should not be his own as to a part, and the Lord's as to a part...
A portion was assigned to the priests by Pharaoh () = that this was ordinated by the Natural... An assigned portion = what is ordinated.
A calf cut into two parts () = good proceeding from the Lord on the one part, and good received by man on the other part. AE 279:7.
(This) was signified by all the sacrifices, of which part was burnt upon the altar, and part was given to the people to eat. Explained.
Makes Heaven in general and in part.
Heaven is distinguished in general, in special, and in part... In part, into innumerable Societies.
From a Society, as from a part, they conclude as to the whole... For, in the most perfect form, the generals are as the parts, and the parts as the generals...
The general performs use to its parts, and the parts perform use to the general; for the general is from the parts, and the parts constitute the general...
In the most perfect form, such as is the form of Heaven, there is a likeness of the parts to the whole... The parts of Heaven are the Societies of which it consists.
That Heaven, in the whole, and in the part, relates to a man... General article.
Spirits from Hell (must) act on the one side, and Spirits from Heaven on the other; man being in the midst.
In such a form is Heaven in the whole, in the part, and in the individual...
This conjunction on the part of the Angel is...
The parts of these (fruits, etc.) are such, from which is the whole. The inmosts, mediates, and outermosts of the parts, are in these degrees...

In a word, the whole comes forth from the parts; and the parts subsist from the whole... In a kingdom, the general comes forth from the men who are the parts; and the parts or men, subsist from the general. It is the same with every Thing which is in any form; and most so in man.
For man to be man, no part must be wanting...
All that inflows from the Lord is use; and it inflows from the parts into the general, and from the general to the parts. The parts, there, are the Angels; and the general is a Society of them.
As the human form is such that all the parts make the general...
Thought from this exterior illustration sees a Thing on both sides...
But by interior illustration from man, man sees a Thing on one side, and not on the other.
Unless by repentance man removes evils as to a part, he remains in them. General article. TCR 522:2.
From this, or from the other two parts, of the globe.
There are two faculties, or parts, of the mind...
On those who... bend others to their own side.
To which the parts of the body correspond.
Its doctrine of falsities is meant by the city broken into three parts ().
Two parts in the universal earth shall be cut off, and shall expire; but the third shall be left therein (). The third part of the earth = some in the Church.

The two parts of the earth () = all the good in the Church. And that something of truth will remain, but scarcely any genuine truth, is signified by, the third part shall be left in it; yet I will bring the third part through the fire, and will prove it...
From this marriage of the Lord and the Church, the Church is the Church in general and in part. The Church in the part is the man in whom is the Church.

In this middle is man while he lives in the world; and, if he is in evil and the derivative falsities, he passes over into the parts of Hell... But if he is in good and the derivative truths, he passes over into the parts of Heaven...
The great city became into three parts () = that all things of the doctrine of truth from the Word have been dissipated... To become into three parts = to be dissipated. Explained.

They thus make three parts in the Lord, when yet there are two: the Divine, and the Human; and these two parts are one Person; and, as soul and body make one man, so the Divine and the Human are one Christ.
The greatest desire (of the Moravians) is to allure others to their own party.
